No actions. I've read enough to reply, and nothing gets built before we've talked it through.

---

Here's how I read it: you want fewer lanes going empty. A member with a booking gets a text at 18:00 the evening before. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" never gets a text from the club. The goal is that people who can't come cancel in time, so someone on the waiting list gets the lane.

What I found in the booking app:

- **No reminders are sent today.** The club already sends its newsletter by text through an SMS provider, so the sending side exists. This work would add the 18:00 job and the message.
- **The opt-out is large.** 23% of members ticked "no texts". Under your spec they'd get no reminder at all.
- **Email doesn't cover them.** 61% of members have no email on file, so it isn't a full fallback.

A smaller point for later: someone who books a lane after 18:00 the evening before would miss the reminder.

Tell me if I've got any of that wrong. The question that would most change what gets built is: **for the members who ticked "no texts", should they get a reminder some other way, or should they just not get one?**

Or if you'd rather I build it exactly as written, say so.
